ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Home ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
